title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
summary: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.
llm_summary: OpenAI’s latest feature, the ChatGPT Wallet, lets AI agents browse stores, add items to a cart and complete purchases entirely on a user’s behalf. The tool is being rolled out first to a small group of U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers, with built‑in safeguards to keep
